title: Year in Review: How We Made Dashing Better in 2026
summary: From new ways to earn and more flexible rewards to tools that help make dashing easier, here's how we improved the Dasher experience this year.
body_markdown:
More than 8 million people dashed this year, each with their own goals, schedules, and reasons for earning on DoorDash. We’re constantly talking to Dashers about their experience, and throughout the year, we used their feedback to make dashing even better.


From **updating our Rewards program** with Overall Rating and expanded access to Dash Now, to introducing **more earning opportunities with Tasks** , and rolling out improved tools to help make dashing even easier with a **new earnings goaling feature,** **improved shelf photos** and **item location information** .


Here's a look back at what we built – including a few updates we're sharing for the first time.


**Improved Dasher Rewards Program** Dashers told us that qualifying for rewards status sometimes felt too rigid, and they wanted a program that gave them more flexibility and multiple ways to qualify for rewards. We used that feedback to introduce a flexible and transparent system that created more ways to qualify for rewards, gave more visibility into performance, and better recognized consistent, high-quality deliveries with new ratings. The result is a comprehensive update to how Dashers qualify for rewards status, access the road, and opportunities to earn.


-


**New Overall Dasher Rating** . We introduced a new Overall Dasher Rating, a single score across six metrics (Acceptance Rate, Completion Rate, Customer Rating, On-Time Rate, Last 30-Day Orders and Quality Rate) that updates in real time after every delivery. In the old system, Dashers had to meet a minimum in every category. Now, overall performance is taken into account to be more flexible, while giving Dashers more ways to reach rewards status. It comes with a brand new experience that gives Dashers more transparency into their ratings, so they can easily track which previous deliveries count towards their ratings.


-


**New Expanded Access to Dash Now** . In most U.S. cities, all Dashers have more availability to go online without scheduling ahead, regardless of rewards status. Dash Now shows more visibility into the best times to dash based on their location and local demand. Dashers who prefer to plan ahead can still use the Schedule tab, while those looking for more flexibility can get on the road and start earning immediately when they want to.


-


**New Offer Boosts For Rewards Tiers** . We rolled out Offer Boosts as another exclusive perk for Dashers with rewards status: Dashers with the highest tiers can expect to receive offers the fastest, which keep them busiest, despite changes to how Dashers access the road. Dashers with higher tiers also get even more priority on the highest-paying offers, in addition to extra pay on deliveries in select places. These perks give a better earning experience to Dashers who consistently provide high-quality service.


-


**Improved On-Time Rate With New Merchant Delay Protection** . We continued improving On-Time Rate by adding new protections to ensure Dashers aren't impacted by delays outside their control, including when merchants are running behind preparing orders. With Merchant Delay Protection, Dashers will see real-time notifications on the pickup screen when we detect a delay outside their control, including when orders are marked ready too early or take longer than expected. Additionally, Dashers will see clearer explanations of why certain deliveries were marked late, providing even more information about how lateness is measured.


-


**New Store Pause** . Platinum and Gold Dashers in some places can now pause offers from up to three stores they would rather skip, for two weeks without any impact on their Acceptance Rate. Whether it’s a restaurant with consistently long wait times or difficult parking that creates more challenging pick ups, this feature gives Dashers even more choice over the deliveries they accept, helping them spend even more time earning on their own terms.


**Updates To Shopping Experience**


From grocery to retail, Shop & Deliver gives Dashers who like to shop another way to earn beyond traditional restaurant deliveries. This year, we introduced new tools to make shopping orders faster, more efficient, and more rewarding to complete, while helping Dashers spend less time locating items in-store and more time earning.


-


**New Updates to Make In-Store Shopping Faster & Easier** . We made updates to help Dashers find items faster, like providing shelf photos and more detailed item location information directly on the shopping list at even more merchants. We also rolled out smarter shopping lists with improved item location information, which makes shopping, finding items, and navigating around the store even faster by reducing any backtracking.


-


**New Rewards for Pro Shoppers** . We’re testing several new rewards for Pro Shoppers in select places, giving Dashers more ways to earn and even more choice in the type of offers they take. This includes exclusive peak pay for Pro Shoppers, the ability to temporarily pause offers from certain Merchants or the option to select to receive shopping offers only.


-


**New Improvements for Fairer Shopping Ratings** . We’ve made updates to the way Shopping Ratings are calculated for Dashers to better account for issues outside of their control, including automatically detecting when Dashers are not responsible for finding an out of stock item and giving them the ability to dispute inaccurate ratings tied to missing or found items, quality of items selected or substitutions.


-


**More Transparency for Heavy or Oversized Orders** . We’ve made updates to more clearly identify heavy and oversized orders on the offer screen. Now, Dashers can see exactly what’s in these larger orders and either decline or unassign before pick up without an impact to their ratings. This helps Dashers have even more insight and choice in the offers they take.


-


**More Ways to Recognize Shoppers** . Shopping orders take time and Dashers told us they wanted customers to better understand the effort involved. Now, customers can see details like estimated shopping time and item count when they tip, giving them more visibility into what goes into completing an order. We've also refreshed the tip screen, so customers can tip in one tap, and Dashers can also send a quick thank you to customers for their tips.


As always, Dashers who would prefer not to do shopping can opt out of Shop and Deliver, with no impact to their ratings or rewards standing.


**Making it Easier for Dashers to Reach Their Goals**


Every Dasher has their own reasons for earning on DoorDash, and whatever they are working towards, we want to make it easier for them to track and reach those goals. This year, we introduced new tools to help Dashers get started on the road, set and track earnings goals, and manage what they do earn with even more ease and flexibility. These are just a few of the ways we're expanding opportunities for Dashers to earn in ways that work best for them.


-


**New Earnings Goaling** . To better help Dashers plan and make the most of their time on the road we’ve introduced new in-app features to set personalized weekly earnings goals based on their dashing history and track their progress directly in the Dasher app, making it easier to plan their schedules, stay on track, and work toward their goals.


-


**Connecting DoorDash Crimson to More Financial Tools With Plaid** . In response to feedback from DoorDash Crimson users, we introduced a new integration with[Plaid](https://about.doordash.com/en-us/news/doordash-crimson-expands-with-plaid-integration) , allowing Dashers to easily and securely connect their Doordash Crimson accounts to more than 12,000 institutions globally and more than 9,000 financial apps and services. This helps Dashers more easily manage their earnings with the tools they already use, without the extra steps.


-


**More Tools for Dashers Getting Started** . We launched[DashBuddy](https://about.doordash.com/en-us/news/dashbuddy) , an SMS assistant that helps new Dashers get quick answers to commonly asked questions about dashing. DashBuddy is helping remove some of the barriers to getting started, has resolved around 95% of questions from Dashers signing up or preparing for their first dash, and Dashers who talk to DashBuddy before their first dash are more likely to complete one within just three days following their chat.*


**Helping Dashers Earn More & Take Their Earnings Further**


We're thinking beyond traditional deliveries when it comes to Dasher earnings. From introducing new opportunities to earn through Tasks to expanding financial tools through DoorDash Crimson and Plaid, we're focused on giving Dashers more ways to earn, manage their money and make the most of every dollar. This year, we also rolled out an emergency gas relief program to help ease the impact of rising prices at the pump.


-


**More Ways To Earn With Tasks** . This year, we introduced[Tasks](https://about.doordash.com/en-us/news/introducing-doordash-tasks) , short activities outside of traditional deliveries that Dashers can complete between drop offs or in their own time, like taking photos of a restaurant's menu or or giving an autonomous vehicle a hand getting back on the road. Since 2024, Dashers have completed more than 5 million tasks and we’re continuing to expand these opportunities to earn.


-


**Gas Relief at the Pump** . After gas prices rose earlier this year, DoorDash launched an[emergency relief program](https://about.doordash.com/en-us/news/gas-price-relief-for-dashers) to help Dashers reduce expenses and save at the pump. Dashers with DoorDash Crimson earned 10% cash back on gas at any U.S. gas station, whether or not they were on a dash, giving eligible Dashers an extra $1.40 to $1.90 in weekly savings per gallon, depending on miles driven while actively completing deliveries. Dashers who drove 125 miles or more while on delivery also received weekly fuel relief payments ranging from $5-$15 based on miles driven.


-


**New Delivery Highlights** . Not every delivery requires the same amount of effort, whether it's carrying heavy grocery bags, navigating longer routes, or managing multiple substitutions. The Delivery Highlights feature gives customers greater visibility into that extra effort at key moments and early results show its encouraged increased post-delivery tips for Dashers in places where the update is being tested.


**Looking Ahead to 2027 and Beyond**


The updates we rolled out this year were shaped by Dasher feedback, and we're excited to build on that progress in 2027. We'll focus on making it easier to get started and creating a more personalized experience, with smarter tools to help Dashers plan when to earn, set goals, and track their progress. We'll also continue refining our Rewards program to better recognize consistent Dashers and provide more relevant in-app guidance. Our focus is always to give every Dasher the flexibility, tools, and support to help earn on their own terms toward their goals.


---


*Based on DoorDash internal data from July 2026 - September 2026.
